title: NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Occupancy Tiers and Coverage Limits Schedule
content:
## NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Occupancy Tiers and Coverage Limits

The NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) are written in six occupancy tiers. Each tier is entered by the occupancy of the insured building or unit, and every tier requires the building to be in a community that participates in the National Flood Insurance Program.

### Who each tier is written for

| Tier (official name) | Occupancy | Insured's interest in the building | Coverages written |
|---|---|---|---|
| NFIP Dwelling Form – Tenant Contents | Residential tenant | Does not own the building | Contents only |
| NFIP Dwelling Form – Residential Condominium Unit | Residential condominium unit | Unit owner | Building and contents |
| NFIP Dwelling Form – Manufactured Home | Residential manufactured or mobile home, anchored on a permanent foundation | Owns the home | Building and contents |
| NFIP Dwelling Form – Secondary Single-Family Home | Single-family home that is not the primary residence | Owns the building | Building and contents |
| NFIP Dwelling Form – Primary Single-Family Home | Single-family home that is the primary residence | Owns the building | Building and contents |
| NFIP Dwelling Form – Two-to-Four Unit Building | Residential building of 2 to 4 units that is not a condominium | Owns the building | Building and contents |

### Coverage availability and limits by tier

| Item | Tenant Contents | Residential Condominium Unit | Manufactured Home | Secondary Single-Family Home | Primary Single-Family Home | Two-to-Four Unit Building |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Building coverage (Coverage A) may be written | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Contents coverage (Coverage B) may be written | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Statutory maximum building coverage (USD) | 0 | 250000 | 250000 | 250000 | 250000 | 250000 |
| Statutory maximum contents coverage (USD) | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 | 100000 |
| Increment in which building and contents limits are written (USD) | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Increased Cost of Compliance coverage (Coverage D) attaches | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Increased Cost of Compliance limit per loss, paid in addition to the building limit (USD; 0 where not available) | 0 | 0 | 30000 | 30000 | 30000 | 30000 |

The building limit and the contents limit are each a ceiling for the coverage on that tier; the Increased Cost of Compliance limit is a separate amount per loss and is paid in addition to the building limit, never out of it.

### Reading the schedule

- **Tenant Contents.** Building coverage is not available, so the statutory maximum building coverage is 0 and the contents ceiling of 100000 is the only limit. No Increased Cost of Compliance coverage attaches (limit 0).
- **Residential Condominium Unit.** Building coverage up to 250000 and contents up to 100000 are available, but Increased Cost of Compliance coverage does not attach (limit 0).
- **Manufactured Home, Secondary Single-Family Home, Primary Single-Family Home and Two-to-Four Unit Building.** Building coverage up to 250000, contents up to 100000, and Increased Cost of Compliance coverage of 30000 per loss.
- **Increments.** On every tier both limits are written in whole multiples of 100 dollars. A hypothetical building limit of 182,450 dollars is therefore not a writable figure, while 182,400 or 182,500 dollars is.
